notes: You must attend all sessions to get the stipend.
name: Teen Museum Studies
what_you_do: A summer museum internship. You learn about museum careers, pick a St. Louis artist and help organize an exhibition at CAM.
who_can_apply: High school students in the St. Louis metro area. CAM aims for a mix of new and returning teens and a mix of art backgrounds.
pay_detail: $500 stipend if you finish the whole program. Public transit costs can be reimbursed.
duration: 2026: May 27 to July 16 (Wed, Thu, Fri 2 to 4 p.m.) plus three sessions Aug to Nov
how_to_apply: The page does not describe how to apply. Applications for 2026 are closed. Learning and Engagement staff review applications.
